messages:
alex: Morning — handing off oncall to @mira at 20:00 PST. Quick notes:
- Postmortem PT-2314 remediation: cache eviction fix deployed to canary (3 hosts). Needs prod verification.
- Rollout: model-fallback v2 at 50% traffic; observed rare NPE under p99 concurrency (trace id 0a3f). Risk: fallback may not trigger on spikes, could increase tail latency.
- Outstanding action from PMT-18: add fallback-enabled metric (assigned to jess).
- Coverage: dan is covering 00:00-04:00 PST tonight.
Ping @mira @dan @jess to verify.

If you run a quick prod smoke, use:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.prod/smoke -d '{"q":"hello"}' | jq -r '.status'
```
Expect "ok" and <=150ms p95.

Also FYI: quota alert threshold adjusted to 90% per finance — keeping an eye on bursts.
Thanks, alex

---
dan: On it. Running the smoke now and will tail the logs for the NPE. If I see the NPE I'll reopen PT-2314 and tag oncall.

---
deploy-bot: [deploy] cache-evict-fix v1.2.3 -> prod started by jess at 18:42 UTC :rocket:

---
mira: Ran smoke at 18:48 UTC — response status: ok, quick summary: p50 45ms, p95 120ms. No errors in last 5m. Sample tail from router logs:
```
2026-06-12T18:47:58Z router-2 INFO request_id=6a8f route=/generate status=200 latency=43ms
2026-06-12T18:48:01Z model-3 INFO cache_hit=false fallback_used=false
2026-06-12T18:48:03Z infra-1 WARN gc_pause=12ms
```
I'll keep monitoring until 22:00 PST and will add the label if everything stays green.

---
jess: Quick update — PR #897 adds an extra null-guard to the fallback handler and a unit test exercising the concurrency path. Link: https://git/repo/pull/897. Requested review from @alex. If approved I'll promote canary -> 100% after midnight.

---
alex: Thanks everyone. @mira please add tag `prod-verified` on PT-2314 if you keep seeing clean smokes. If no regressions by 00:30 I'll greenlight the full rollout.

---
mira: Added tag `prod-verified` to PT-2314. No regressions so far. Also pinged infra to add PMT-18 metric (they acknowledged). Will post if anything changes.

---
dan: Noted. Taking the 00:00-04:00 slot. If I see any spike I'll escalate and reopen PT-2314. Otherwise low-touch. :thumbsup:
